# ARCO Global Media

> ARCO Global Media connects high-growth, global leagues and publishers with U.S. marketers. A New York-based sports media representation firm. It acts as the U.S. sales desk for international sports properties: leagues, federations and publishers hire ARCO to package and sell their United States sponsorship and media inventory, and U.S. brands and agencies use ARCO as a single point of contact to buy across the whole roster.

Tagline: Visible. Valued. Viable.
Founded and led by: Ben Rabunski, Founder
Location: New York, NY, United States
Contact: ben@arcoglobalmedia.com
Website: https://arcoglobalmedia.com/

## What ARCO does

For leagues, federations and publishers:
- Packages unsold U.S. inventory into named, sponsorable franchises with a price and a KPI.
- Pitches directly to CMOs and agency investment leads.
- Removes the need to build a U.S. entity, sales team or local overhead.

For brands and agencies:
- One brief and one point of contact across every represented property.
- Title positions and tentpole moments rather than remnant impressions.
- Brief to named franchise to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters.

## Properties represented

- Serie A — football (soccer), Italy
- Manchester City — football (soccer), England
- City Football Group — club ownership group, 13 clubs across 5 continents
- Major League Cricket — cricket, United States
- PPA Tour — professional pickleball tour
- Major League Pickleball — pickleball team league
- Pickleball Inc. — parent company of the PPA Tour and Major League Pickleball
- International Judo Federation — international judo federation, 200 member nations
- International Flag League — professional 5v5 flag football
- The Publisher Desk — enthusiast publisher network

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/): positioning, roster, values, advisory board, contact.
- [Properties](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/properties): the full roster, what ARCO sells for each property, and official references.
- [FAQ](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/faq): what ARCO does, who it represents, and how a deal gets built.
- [Market coverage](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/press): third-party reporting on the markets ARCO represents and the investment moving into them.
- [Brand kit](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/brand-kit): logo lockups, colour values, typography and approved boilerplate.
- [Case study: Toys"R"Us x PPA Finals](https://arcoglobalmedia.com/case-study): a national retail brand taking the title position at a professional pickleball championship. 14,894 total attendance, 400,000+ viewers across FOX, FS1, FS2 and Pickleball TV, and a 44% lift on the prior year's sole FOX window.

## About the founder

Ben Rabunski has two decades in media and sports sales, including roles at Twitch, WarnerMedia, Amazon, CBS, The Economist and Univision.
